params._usdc: USDC token address for this deployment.              Arc Testnet: 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000              Arc Mainnet: set at mainnet deploy time.

params.amounts: Corresponding USDC amounts (6 decimals). Equal split: caller computes equal shares.
params.name: Human-readable pot name.

fund(uint256,uint256).details: Uses balance-delta accounting to handle fee-on-transfer tokens defensively.

payAll(uint256).details: All-or-nothing: if any individual transfer reverts, the whole transaction reverts.      Requires pot to be sufficiently funded (fundedAmount >= totalAllocated).      Does NOT close the pot — call closePot() when satisfied.      For resilient best-effort payout (skip failures), use payBestEffort().

payBestEffort(uint256).details: Resilient variant. Failed recipients can be retried with retryFailed() / retryFailedRange().      Does NOT require full funding. Does NOT close the pot.

retryFailed(uint256).details: Use retryFailedRange for large pots to avoid gas DoS.

closePot(uint256).notice: Close the pot. Required before withdraw(). Owner confirms payout state is acceptable.

fund(uint256,uint256).notice: Fund a pot by transferring USDC from the caller.

payAll(uint256).notice: Pay all unpaid recipients atomically. Reverts if any transfer fails.

payBestEffort(uint256).notice: Best-effort payout: skips recipients whose transfer fails, marking them `failed`.

payRange(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Pay a bounded range of recipients (for large pots exceeding block gas).

retryFailed(uint256).notice: Retry previously failed recipients. Best-effort: still marks failed on second failure.

retryFailedRange(uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: Retry failed recipients in a bounded range (for large pots).

usdc().notice: The only ERC-20 token accepted by this distributor (USDC).

withdraw(uint256,address).notice: Withdraw remaining USDC (overfunding or failed-recipient residual) after pot is closed.
